story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to book a venue for the times my event needs, in 15-minute steps, so that a venue is not held for a whole morning, afternoon or night when the event needs only part of it

acceptance_criteria.text: A venue booking request is made for a start time and an end time on a 15-minute grid (e.g. 10:00–12:15), not by choosing AM, PM or Night slots.
The requested times default to the event's (or the session's) own start and end, widened to the nearest 15 minutes where they do not fall on the grid.
Given a start or end time is not on a 15-minute boundary, or the end is not after the start, when the request is submitted, then it is refused and the time is identified.
Any period within the venue's opening hours can be booked; there is no fixed lunch or dinner blackout.
Each venue's setup time and turnaround time are set in minutes, in 15-minute steps (including zero), instead of whole adjacent slots.
When availability and conflicts are checked, a booking occupies the venue from its start minus the venue's setup time to its end plus the venue's turnaround time.
Two bookings at the same venue conflict when their occupied periods overlap; occupied periods that only meet end to start do not conflict.
Venue Staff reviewing a request see the requested times and the occupied period including setup and turnaround.
The venue availability calendar shows bookings, holds and unavailable periods at their actual times, with setup and turnaround shown separately from the booked time.
